Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, to be performed 
 every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The first

 Ahmed Abdel

This document accepted by 
eng.

MPIS coordinator, 
and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: EDEPC 
planning & financial prediction head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Safety 
 and healthy equipment 
 must be used (safety shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety 
 glasses).
Never use flammable solvents or carbon tetrachloride for 
 cleaning
Never weld or perform any operation involving heat near the 
 oil system. Oil tanks must be completely purged never weld on, or in any way 
 modify, pressure vessels.
Never use caustic solvents which can damage materials of the 
 air net, e.g. poly-carbonate bowls.
